title: Rune-Jit Runecraft Skill Data
description: JSON Schema for data/skills/runecraft.yaml. The Runecraft data shape (altars + per-rune multiple-rune thresholds) diverges from the shared skill-data.schema.json (axes/trees), so it has its own schema. Validate with: python3 -c "import jsonschema, yaml, json; jsonschema.validate(yaml.safe_load(open('data/skills/runecraft.yaml')), json.load(open('data/schemas/runecraft-data.schema.json')))"

meta.description: Skill-level metadata consumed by the plugin at startup.

skill.description: OSRS skill enum name (must be RUNECRAFT)

ticks_per_attempt.description: Game ticks per crafting action (1 tick = 0.6s)

rune_essence_item_id.description: Rune essence item ID (used by low-level altars)

pure_essence_item_id.description: Pure essence item ID (used by members altars)

altars.description: All rune altars keyed by constant name (e.g. AIR, NATURE).

level_required.description: Runecraft level required to craft this rune

xp_per_essence.description: XP awarded per essence crafted (exact wiki value)

rune_item_id.description: Item ID of the rune produced

essence_item_id.description: Item ID of the essence consumed (rune or pure essence)

altar_object_id.description: Object ID of the altar (verify from cache)

talisman_item_id.description: Talisman item ID to enter the ruin (null where no ItemIds constant exists)

multiple_thresholds.description: Ordered level->runes_per_essence breakpoints. The highest entry whose level is <= the player's level applies.

level.description: Runecraft level at which this multiplier becomes active

runes_per_essence.description: Runes produced per essence at or above this level

wiki.description: OSRS wiki URL for this rune (required citation)
